clue.text: Being enthusiastic with detailed planning after European Union

indicators.note: after places the planning word behind the Union's abbreviation

parts.note: logistic describes something concerned with the detailed organisation of an operation

explanation.surface: Someone gets excited about meticulous organisation following a Brussels decision.
explanation.definitionFit: Eulogistic speech is full of praise, so it is warmly enthusiastic about its subject.

clue.text: Concentrate? It's hard after new member of comedy duo comes around

indicators.note: after puts the hard letter behind the comedian's name
the comedian's name comes around, enclosing the letter for new

parts.note: Eric Morecambe was one half of the British double act Morecambe and Wise
H is the pencil-grading abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: A puzzled call to focus, as one of a famous comic pair reappears.
explanation.walkthrough: Eric Morecambe was half of Morecambe and Wise, a much-loved British comedy duo.
explanation.definitionFit: To enrich uranium is to concentrate its fissile isotope, a technical synonym.

clue.text: Keen to have gold fabric on holy books

indicators.note: in a down clue, on puts the fabric above the books

parts.note: lamé is a fabric woven with gold or silver thread
NT is the New Testament, a set of holy books

explanation.surface: An eager person wants gold cloth draped over scripture.
explanation.definitionFit: To keen is to wail in grief, so it is a synonym of mourn aloud in sorrow.

clue.text: Useless person that could conceivably make Waterloo subject to flooding

parts.words: that could conceivably make Waterloo subject to flooding
parts.note: read as an instruction, swapping G (good) for O (nothing) turns WATERLOO into WATERLOG, meaning to flood

explanation.surface: A layabout who might somehow get a London station flooded.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as an instruction: put G (good) for O (nothing) and Waterloo becomes waterlog, to soak with water.
explanation.definitionFit: A layabout or waster is called this, an idiom for someone of no use at all.

clue.text: One with special powers ahead with the Queen carried by prancing horse

indicators.note: the jumbled animal carries the other letters inside it
a prancing horse moves about wildly, so its letters are jumbled

parts.note: up means ahead, as a team two up is leading
ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for the Queen

explanation.surface: A royal rider, with the monarch aboard a lively steed, leading the way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'prancing' rearranges HORSE to SHERO, and 'carried by' puts UPER inside it after the S.
explanation.definitionFit: A comic-book hero such as Superman is defined by abilities beyond ordinary humans.

clue.text: Old Greek trapped by overambition — Icarus

indicators.note: the letters sit trapped inside the run of the two words

explanation.surface: A figure from Greek myth undone by flying too high.
explanation.walkthrough: Icarus flew too close to the sun on wax wings, so 'overambition' fits the story.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ionians were one of the main ancient Greek peoples, and their dialect and style bear this name.

clue.text: Tiny amount of holiday in spring

definitions.meaning: a jot or iota, as in not caring one bit
Whitsun, the festival of Pentecost, gave a British bank holiday in late spring

explanation.surface: Barely any time off during the spring.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a jot or iota; the other is short for Whitsun, a spring church festival and holiday.

clue.text: Junior doctors in hospital warning about treatment

parts.note: H is the map and road-sign abbreviation for hospital

indicators.note: the warning word goes about the treatment word

parts.note: an omen is a warning sign
use means treatment, as in rough use

explanation.surface: Trainee medics on a ward issue a caution about care.
explanation.walkthrough: In British usage a houseman is a newly qualified hospital doctor.
explanation.definitionFit: In Britain the term names newly qualified doctors doing hospital residency.

clue.text: Break in spring in lock

indicators.note: the spring word sits in the lock word

parts.note: a tress is a lock of hair
a spa is a mineral spring

explanation.surface: A burglary in springtime through a lock.
explanation.definitionFit: To trespass is to enter unlawfully, a close synonym of entering without permission.

clue.text: Olympic cyclist's father makes a stack in Scotland

definitions.meaning: Sir Chris Hoy is a British Olympic track cycling champion; his dad would be his old man
a famous sea stack, a rock pillar, off the island of Hoy in Orkney

explanation.surface: A sporting dad builds a pile north of the border.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names Orkney's famous sea stack and, read literally, Chris Hoy's dad.

clue.text: This person wearing jumper is amorous type

indicators.note: the jumper wears the setter's pronoun inside it

parts.note: a roo, a kangaroo, is a jumper
the setter refers to themself as this person, so me

explanation.surface: The setter in a knitted sweater is a romantic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jumper' suggests a sweater, but here it is a kangaroo.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's lover gives his name to any ardent male suitor.

clue.text: Writer from old days you style vacuously as flat

parts.note: a pen is something you write with
thou is the archaic form of you

indicators.note: emptied of its contents, the word keeps only its first and last letters

explanation.surface: An old-fashioned author calls your style empty and dull.
explanation.definitionFit: A luxury apartment on a building's top floor is a kind of flat.

clue.text: What could produce fir cone

indicators.note: the two words could produce a new word when their letters are reworked

explanation.surface: Where do pine cones come from?
explanation.walkthrough: Whole clue is both definition and wordplay: the tree that bears them, and an anagram of FIR CONE.
explanation.definitionFit: A cone-bearing tree such as a fir is the source of fir cones.

clue.text: Get beaten in knockout competition but reduce the deficit

indicators.note: the losing word goes in the cup

parts.note: a cup is a knockout tournament, like the FA Cup
to lose is to get beaten

explanation.surface: A team falls in a cup tie but narrows the margin first.
explanation.definitionFit: To close up is to narrow a gap, as a trailing side does when it reduces a lead.

clue.text: Emergency vehicle dodges around beset by environmentalists

indicators.note: the scrambled letters are beset, surrounded, by the campaigners

parts.note: the Greens are environmental campaigners

indicators.note: around signals the letters of dodges moved about

explanation.surface: An ambulance weaves past eco-protesters blocking its route.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' is the anagram signal and 'beset by' the container. The Green Goddess was a British army fire engine used in firefighters' strikes.
explanation.definitionFit: The nickname belongs to an old green army fire engine, an emergency vehicle.

clue.text: Like a coward clutching contents of till — innocent?

indicators.note: the cowardly word clutches the inner letters

parts.note: gutless means lacking courage, like a coward

indicators.note: the contents are the inner letters of the word

explanation.surface: A timid suspect grabs cash from the register yet pleads innocence.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone free of blame or wrongdoing is blameless, without guilt.

clue.text: What violinist will do before and after performance

definitions.text: What violinist will do before and after performance

parts.words: What violinist will do before and after performance
parts.note: before playing a violinist picks up the stick for the strings; afterwards bends to acknowledge applause

explanation.surface: A musician's routine either side of a concert.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both picking up the bow for strings and bowing to the audience.

clue.text: Inexperienced traitors shot up by southern defence system

indicators.note: in a down clue, shot up sends the words upward, reading backwards

parts.note: raw means inexperienced, as a raw recruit
rats are traitors, people who desert their side

explanation.surface: Green turncoats gunned down by a southern force.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shot up' turns RAWRATS into STARWAR. Star Wars was the nickname of Reagan's Strategic Defense Initiative.
explanation.definitionFit: The nickname was given to the US Strategic Defense Initiative, a missile shield.

clue.text: Such an observation could construe Mars location

definitions.note: the adjective describes the kind of observation: one of the heavens

indicators.note: to construe is to interpret, so the letters can be read in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Pinpointing the red planet would be a telescope sighting.
explanation.definitionFit: A sighting of a planet's position is an observation of the stars and planets.

clue.text: I get in flashing light

indicators.note: flashing suggests quick, scattered movement, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone stepping into a strobe light.
explanation.definitionFit: To light a fire is to set it burning, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Tear into pen like a zebra

indicators.note: the tear word goes into the pen word

parts.note: a sty is a pen for pigs
to rip is to tear

explanation.surface: An animal bursts through an enclosure, zoo-style.
explanation.definitionFit: A zebra's coat is marked with bands, so it is banded or striped.

clue.text: Nothing in Heart's broadcast for range of listeners?

indicators.note: the zero goes in the scattered letters
broadcast scatters the letters widely, an anagram signal

parts.note: O, the figure zero, means nothing

explanation.surface: A radio station's audience reach described as zero.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' rearranges HEARTS to EARSHT; 'in' puts O inside it. Heart is a British radio station.
explanation.definitionFit: The distance within which sound can be heard is the range over which listeners can hear.

clue.text: One making effort right to break rank

indicators.note: the right letter breaks into the rank word

parts.note: a tier is a rank or row

explanation.surface: A soldier striving to break ranks.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who tries hard is one who makes an attempt.

clue.text: Husband restrained by hard time had an idea

indicators.note: the husband letter is held inside the hard word

parts.note: tough means hard
H is the genealogical abbreviation for husband

explanation.surface: A spouse, held back during a difficult period, came up with a plan.
explanation.definitionFit: Having had an idea is to have pondered or conceived it, past tense of think.

clue.text: Stand in sea in disguise that may be put on to fish

definitions.text: that may be put on to fish

parts.note: to bear is to stand, as in can't stand it

indicators.note: disguised letters are rearranged to hide them

explanation.surface: Something to wear while angling in the sea, as a disguise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in disguise' rearranges IN SEA to NAISE.
explanation.definitionFit: This rich butter-and-egg sauce is poured over fish and steak.

clue.text: Strike covers area and island somewhere in the Caribbean

indicators.note: the strike word covers the area letter

parts.note: to hit is to strike

explanation.surface: A storm hits a region and an island in the West Indies.
explanation.definitionFit: The nation shares Hispaniola, an island in the Caribbean Sea.

clue.text: Women's group — mum's desire

parts.note: the WI is the Women's Institute, a British women's organisation
mum means keep quiet, which sh demands

explanation.surface: What a mother wants from her women's club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mum' looks like a mother but means silence, as in keep mum. The WI is the Women's Institute, a British community group for women.
explanation.definitionFit: A want or longing for something is a desire.

clue.text: Snoop around about small storage space in part of church

indicators.note: the snoop word goes around the other pieces

parts.note: to pry is to snoop
re means about, concerning
a byte is a unit of computer storage

explanation.surface: A busybody rummages through a cupboard in a church.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the eastern section of a church reserved for clergy, near the altar.
